candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can call it and change the balance.
Replace withdrawAll body to withdraw only 1 wei instead of the full balance.
Change transfer target from msg.sender to owner so withdraw sends funds to owner instead of caller.
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw does nothing, leaving balance unchanged.
Use call instead of transfer, which can fail silently and leave balance unchanged if recipient reverts.
Delete require check so anyone can call withdraw, potentially draining funds and changing balance.
Invert require condition so only non-owners can call withdraw, preventing owner from withdrawing.
Delete the require statement that checks the return value of the low-level call, so a failed send does not revert.
Replace the call value with 0 so that no Ether is actually sent, changing the balance after the call.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call sendMoney.
